import MilneLib.Sheaf.QuasicoherentSectionsRestriction
import MilneLib.Sheaf.EquivariantModuleSections

/-!
# Native section-ring base change on basic opens

Restriction of a quasicoherent sheaf to a basic open is base change over the
actual global section ring. The comparison uses the same restriction map and
scalar actions as the equivariant sheaf-section API.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry
open MilneLib.StableGroupAction.ModuleLinearization
open scoped TensorProduct

namespace MilneLib

variable {R : CommRingCat.{u}}

private theorem algebraMap_globalSections (r : R) :
    algebraMap R Γ(Spec R, ⊤) r = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv r := by
  change ((Spec R).presheaf.map (𝟙 (Opposite.op (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens))))
    ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv r) = _
  simp

/-- Localizing the native restriction map uses the section corresponding to
the basic-open equation under the affine global-sections isomorphism. -/
theorem quasicoherent_nativeBasicOpenRestriction_isLocalizedModule
    (F : (Spec R).Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (f : R) :
    letI := sectionsRestrictionModule F (le_top : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ ⊤)
    IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv f))
      (sectionsRestrictionLinearMap F
        (le_top : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ ⊤)) := by
  letI := sectionsRestrictionModule F (le_top : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ ⊤)
  letI : IsScalarTower R Γ(Spec R, ⊤) Γ(F, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_smul
    intro r m
    change (show Γ(Spec R, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) from (Spec R).presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (le_top : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ ⊤)).op
      (algebraMap R Γ(Spec R, ⊤) r)) • m = r • m
    rw [algebraMap_globalSections r, Scheme.Modules.smul_Spec_def]
    rfl
  letI : IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f)
      ((sectionsRestrictionLinearMap F
        (le_top : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ ⊤)).restrictScalars R) :=
    qcoh_section_isLocalizedModule F f
  have h := IsLocalizedModule.of_restrictScalars (Submonoid.powers f)
    (sectionsRestrictionLinearMap F (le_top : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ ⊤))
  simpa only [Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid_powers, algebraMap_globalSections f] using h

/-- Native restriction to a basic open realizes base change over the actual
global section ring, using restriction on both scalars and sheaf sections. -/
theorem quasicoherent_nativeBasicOpenRestriction_isBaseChange
    (F : (Spec R).Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (f : R) :
    letI : Algebra Γ(Spec R, ⊤) Γ(Spec R, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) :=
      (Spec R).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (le_top : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ ⊤)).op |>.hom.toAlgebra
    letI := sectionsRestrictionModule F (le_top : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ ⊤)
    letI : IsScalarTower Γ(Spec R, ⊤) Γ(Spec R, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f)
        Γ(F, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) :=
      IsScalarTower.of_compHom _ _ _
    IsBaseChange Γ(Spec R, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f)
      (sectionsRestrictionLinearMap F
        (le_top : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ ⊤)) := by
  letI : Algebra Γ(Spec R, ⊤) Γ(Spec R, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) :=
    (Spec R).presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (le_top : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ ⊤)).op |>.hom.toAlgebra
  letI := sectionsRestrictionModule F (le_top : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ ⊤)
  letI : IsScalarTower Γ(Spec R, ⊤) Γ(Spec R, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f)
      Γ(F, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) := IsScalarTower.of_compHom _ _ _
  letI : IsLocalization.Away ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv f)
      Γ(Spec R, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) :=
    (isAffineOpen_top (Spec R)).isLocalization_of_eq_basicOpen
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv f) (homOfLE le_top) (basicOpen_eq_of_affine f).symm
  letI := quasicoherent_nativeBasicOpenRestriction_isLocalizedModule F f
  exact IsLocalizedModule.isBaseChange (Submonoid.powers ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv f))
    Γ(Spec R, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) _

/-- The literal ordinary comparison required by invariant-module descent is
bijective on a basic open, with coefficients in the actual global section ring. -/
theorem quasicoherent_nativeBasicOpenRestriction_moduleBaseChangeMap_bijective
    (F : (Spec R).Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (f : R) :
    letI : Algebra Γ(Spec R, ⊤) Γ(Spec R, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) :=
      (Spec R).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (le_top : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ ⊤)).op |>.hom.toAlgebra
    letI := sectionsRestrictionModule F (le_top : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ ⊤)
    letI : IsScalarTower Γ(Spec R, ⊤) Γ(Spec R, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f)
        Γ(F, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) := IsScalarTower.of_compHom _ _ _
    Function.Bijective (GaloisDescent.SemilinearAction.moduleBaseChangeMap
      Γ(Spec R, ⊤) Γ(Spec R, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f)
      Γ(F, ⊤) Γ(F, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f)
      (sectionsRestrictionLinearMap F
        (le_top : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ ⊤))) := by
  letI : Algebra Γ(Spec R, ⊤) Γ(Spec R, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) :=
    (Spec R).presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (le_top : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ ⊤)).op |>.hom.toAlgebra
  letI := sectionsRestrictionModule F (le_top : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ ⊤)
  letI : IsScalarTower Γ(Spec R, ⊤) Γ(Spec R, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f)
      Γ(F, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) := IsScalarTower.of_compHom _ _ _
  have h := quasicoherent_nativeBasicOpenRestriction_isBaseChange F f
  have heq : GaloisDescent.SemilinearAction.moduleBaseChangeMap
      Γ(Spec R, ⊤) Γ(Spec R, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f)
      Γ(F, ⊤) Γ(F, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f)
      (sectionsRestrictionLinearMap F
        (le_top : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ ⊤)) = h.equiv.toLinearMap := by
    ext a
    rfl
  rw [heq]
  exact h.equiv.bijective

end MilneLib
